race.description: Book Your Xmas Function At PLRC Hcp (54)
race.comment: EQUINE HEADLINE (3) resumed with a bold second by a neck here 3 weeks ago, and he faces a similar set up here, except with an extra 210m to travel. His only win came on this track, and he can go one better. THE HASS (4) is a durable veteran who has not won for some time, and he maps to receive the run of the race after drawing in the pole position. Each way all day. ALFANO (5) is another 8YO gelding experiencing a win drought, and he needed his first run back from a spell when finishing fourth here 3 weeks ago over 1000m. He improves when stepping up in trip, and he can figure in the top 3 this time. PRESCIENT (2) is a 9YO gelding trained on the course, and he usually saves his best for his home circuit. A wide gate is no help, but he is still worth including in all combos. IN YOUR WORDS (9) was a beaten favourite fresh up, and she cops a tough gate here. She is better than that, so follow your money.
